blocks.text: The University of the Philippines College of Music will hold a commemorative concert entitled “Aagos ang Kundiman” to honor the centennial of renowned Filipino composer Nicanor Abelardo’s iconic kundiman-kumintang “Mutya ng Pasig.” The concert, set to be held at the UP Theater Lobby on Nov. 24 at 6:30 p.m., will feature the UP Madrigal Singers, UP TUGMA as well as Filipino singer-songwriter Joey Ayala. Other performers include UP College of Music students, faculty, staff and alumni — among them Vyktoria Baile, Filianne Villaflor, Carmelite Salvador, Kzee Delos Santos, Ivanna Cruz, Marcus Mallonga, Jhon Michael Mauricio, Mark Nicholson Jaluag, Krisleen Andya Bareng, […]...
